feed.title: Ripple / 涟漪
feed.subtitle: Guides and comparisons from the developer of Ripple, a free app blocker for Android and iPhone, for adults and for parents.

entry.title: Who should hold the unlock code of a phone limit app, and what if it is lost
entry.summary: Adults give the Ripple unlock code to a partner or friend, parents keep it for a kid's phone. Android v0.1.28: Unlock code only needs 8 to 12 digits, 5 wrong tries mean a 1 minute wait, a lost code is removed by request after 72 hours. iPhone v0.1.5 also has an unlock code.

entry.title: 戒手机 App 的解锁码交给谁保管，忘了或输错怎么办
entry.summary: 大人把涟漪解锁码交给另一半或朋友，孩子手机上的码家长留着。安卓 v0.1.28「只能用解锁码」要 8 到 12 位数字，连续输错 5 次等 1 分钟，忘了申请 72 小时后解除。iPhone v0.1.5 也有解锁码。

entry.title: Offline parental control for Android with no account, no cloud and no parent app
entry.summary: Ripple for Android v0.1.28 needs no account or parent app; rules, timers and the unlock code are enforced on the child's phone and work offline; no remote management.

entry.title: 家长管孩子手机，不联网不注册账号，安卓有什么办法
entry.summary: 涟漪安卓 v0.1.28 不用账号和家长端，规则、计时和解锁码在孩子手机本机执行，断网照常拦；没有远程管理。

entry.title: Ripple vs WillStone (自律石头)
entry.summary: WillStone trades good habits for screen time and has a membership; Ripple is free with no account and focuses on strict mode, unlock code, Anti-Uninstall and clock protection on Android v0.1.28.

entry.title: 涟漪和自律石头（WillStone）有什么区别
entry.summary: 自律石头用好习惯换娱乐时间，上了应用商店，部分功能要会员；涟漪全部免费不用账号，安卓 v0.1.28 有严格模式、解锁码、防卸载和防改时间，没有兑换玩法。

entry.title: How to see one app's daily usage for the last 7 or 30 days on Android
entry.summary: Ripple for Android v0.1.27 and later shows one app's usage for each of the last 7 or 30 days with the daily average, top day and total, stored on the phone. iPhone v0.1.5 has no usage page.

entry.title: 安卓怎么看某个 App 最近 7 天、30 天每天用了多久
entry.summary: 涟漪安卓 v0.1.27 起可以看单个 App 最近 7 天和 30 天每天用了多久，有日均、最多的一天和合计，数据只在手机上。iPhone v0.1.5 没有用量页。

entry.title: Is there a free Android app blocker with no ads?
entry.summary: Ripple for Android v0.1.28 is free with no ads: per app daily limits, uninstall protection, clock change resistance. iPhone v0.1.5 only blocks by schedule.

entry.title: 有没有免费又没广告的安卓戒手机 App
entry.summary: 涟漪安卓 v0.1.28 免费无广告，能设每个 App 每天用多久、防卸载、防改时间。iPhone v0.1.5 只能按时段屏蔽。

entry.title: How to limit one app on a child's phone to a set time a day
entry.summary: Set a daily minute limit on the child's Android phone with Ripple, split weekdays and weekends, parent keeps the code. iPhone v0.1.5 has no daily limit.

entry.title: 怎么限制孩子手机上某个 App 每天用多久
entry.summary: 在孩子的安卓手机上用涟漪设每日分钟数，工作日周末分开，家长保管解锁码。iPhone v0.1.5 没有每日时长。

entry.title: Why did I ask for more time? Writing down the reason and a plan when the limit runs out
entry.summary: How reasons and plans work in Ripple for Android v0.1.28 for adults and parents, what iPhone v0.1.5 has, and what was not tested yet.

entry.title: 时间用完又想续，到底为什么？续时间时点个原因、定个计划
entry.summary: 涟漪安卓 v0.1.28 的原因和计划大人和家长怎么用，iPhone v0.1.5 有什么，哪些还没真机测过。

entry.title: Sleepovers: kids up all night on phones at a friend's house, adults scrolling in a guest bed
entry.summary: How parents and adults can set Ripple before a sleepover on Android v0.1.28 and iPhone v0.1.5, and what Ripple cannot do.

entry.summary: 家长和大人去别人家过夜前怎么在涟漪安卓 v0.1.28 和 iPhone v0.1.5 上设规则，以及涟漪做不到什么。

entry.title: Winter break at home: kids on the tablet all day, adults scrolling through year-end leave
entry.summary: How adults and parents can set Ripple for a winter break schedule on Android v0.1.28 and iPhone v0.1.5, and what Ripple cannot do.

entry.summary: What Android v0.1.28 adds on block screens (sleep sounds and slow breathing, no way back to the blocked app), how adults and parents can use it, what was not tested on a real phone, and what iPhone v0.1.5 can do.

entry.summary: 安卓 v0.1.28 拦截页上的听助眠音和慢呼吸，大人和家长怎么用，哪些还没在真机上测过，以及 iPhone v0.1.5 能做什么。

entry.title: Slow breathing and sleep sounds on the phone break screen, for you and your kid
entry.summary: What the Android v0.1.28 break screen offers (sleep sounds and slow breathing while the timer runs), how adults and parents can use it, what was not tested on a real phone, and what iPhone v0.1.5 can do.

entry.title: 刷手机停不下来：休息页上做几轮慢呼吸，大人孩子都能用
entry.summary: 安卓 v0.1.28 休息页上的听助眠音和慢呼吸，大人和家长怎么用，哪些还没在真机上测过，以及 iPhone v0.1.5 能做什么。

entry.title: Ripple vs TiedSiren and Holdfast: strict Android blockers and short video feed blockers
entry.summary: TiedSiren locks timed sessions on Android and its Strict Mode needs a Pro subscription. Holdfast blocks Reels, Shorts and TikTok For You inside the apps. Ripple is free with no account, has strict mode with an unlock code someone else can keep, and can limit only Shorts, Reels or WeChat Channels.

entry.title: 涟漪、TiedSiren 和 Holdfast 怎么选：严格的安卓限制 App 和只关短视频的 App
entry.summary: TiedSiren 能在安卓上锁住一段时间，严格模式要订阅 Pro。Holdfast 在 App 里只关 Reels、Shorts 和 TikTok 推荐页。涟漪免费不用注册，严格模式的解锁码可以交给别人保管，也能只限制 Shorts、Reels 或视频号。

entry.title: Broke your phone limits again? How to start over on your own phone and your child's phone
entry.summary: Why phone limits fall apart, how adults and parents set them up again with one rule at a time, the usage calendar, strict mode and a new unlock code, and a plan for the first week. Ripple Android v0.1.28, iPhone v0.1.5.

entry.title: 又没管住手机怎么办：自己破戒和孩子绕过限制以后怎么重新开始
entry.summary: 限制为什么会崩，大人和家长怎么一条一条重新设，用使用统计日历、严格模式和新解锁码，以及第一周怎么安排。涟漪安卓 v0.1.28，iPhone v0.1.5。

entry.title: App limits suddenly stopped working? A checklist for your own phone and your child's phone
entry.summary: Common reasons a blocker stops blocking (accessibility service off, battery saving, a loosened rule, an old version), steps to check on Android and iPhone, and the diagnostic log export added in Ripple for Android v0.1.22.

entry.title: 手机限制突然不管用了怎么办：自己的手机和孩子的手机都能照着查
entry.summary: 限制不拦了的常见原因（无障碍服务被关、省电冻结、规则被放松、版本旧），安卓和 iPhone 的排查步骤，以及涟漪安卓 v0.1.23 新加的导出诊断日志。

entry.title: All Ripple comparisons on one page: app blockers and parental controls for Android and iPhone
entry.summary: Every comparison between Ripple and other app blockers, focus apps and parental controls, grouped by built in tools, limiting your own phone, limiting a child's phone and apps popular in China.

entry.title: 涟漪全部对比页：限制 App 和家长控制 App 怎么选
entry.summary: 涟漪和其他限制 App、专注 App、家长控制 App 的对比页都在这一页，按手机自带工具、国内常见、大人管自己、家长管孩子分组。

entry.title: Ripple vs Zenze and Mobicip: a free app blocker or a paid parental control
entry.summary: Zenze is a free Android blocker with ads, a score and leaderboards. Mobicip is a paid parental control with remote management, filtering and location on iPhone and Android. Ripple is free with no account and gives each app a plain daily cap, with an unlock code someone else can keep.

entry.title: 涟漪、Zenze 和 Mobicip 怎么选：免费限制 App 还是付费家长控制
entry.summary: Zenze 是有广告、分数和排行榜的免费安卓限制 App。Mobicip 是按年付费的家长控制，能远程管理、过滤网站和定位。涟漪免费不用注册，给每个 App 设简单的每日时长，解锁码可以交给别人保管。

entry.title: Ripple vs Bu Zuo Shou Ji Kong and Tomato ToDo: Chinese focus apps compared
entry.summary: Tomato ToDo is best for timed study sessions and study rooms. Bu Zuo Shou Ji Kong gives the most control on Android, with many settings and a membership. Ripple is free with no account and gives each app a plain daily cap, with an unlock code someone else can keep.

entry.title: 涟漪、不做手机控和番茄ToDo怎么选：大人管自己和家长管孩子
entry.summary: 番茄ToDo 适合按番茄钟学习和进自习室，不做手机控在安卓上管得最细但设置多、有会员。涟漪免费不用注册，给每个 App 设简单的每日时长，解锁码可以交给别人保管。

entry.title: Ripple vs Microsoft Family Safety: app limits for parents and adults
entry.summary: Microsoft Family Safety limits apps and games across Windows, Xbox and Android for families with Microsoft accounts, but does not limit apps on an iPhone. Ripple is free with no account and sets hard per app limits on one Android phone, with an unlock code someone else can keep.

entry.title: 涟漪和微软家庭安全怎么选：家长管孩子和大人管自己
entry.summary: 微软家庭安全能让游戏和应用时长在 Windows、Xbox 和安卓之间合计，但限制不了 iPhone 上的 App。涟漪免费不用注册，在一台安卓手机上按 App 设硬上限，解锁码可以交给别人保管。

entry.title: Ripple vs TimeLimit.io and DetoxDroid: free app limits on Android
entry.summary: TimeLimit.io is open source parental control with child profiles and a connected mode. DetoxDroid is an open source detox app with grayscale and doom scrolling breaks. Ripple is free with no account but not open source, and sets hard per app limits with an unlock code someone else can keep.

entry.title: 涟漪和 TimeLimit.io、DetoxDroid 怎么选：安卓免费限制 App
entry.summary: TimeLimit.io 是开源家长管控，能建多个孩子用户和联网管理。DetoxDroid 是开源数字排毒 App，有黑白屏和打断刷屏。涟漪免费不用注册但不开源，按 App 设硬上限，解锁码可以交给别人保管。

entry.title: Ripple vs OurPact and Norton Family: phone limits for parents and adults
entry.summary: OurPact and Norton Family are paid parental control services with remote rules, monitoring and location. Ripple is free with no account and sets per app limits on the phone itself, for a child's phone you can set up in person or for your own. OurPact skips Xiaomi, Oppo, Honor and OnePlus phones.

entry.title: 涟漪和 OurPact、Norton Family 怎么选：家长管孩子手机和大人管自己
entry.summary: OurPact 和 Norton Family 是付费家长管控服务，能远程改规则、监控和定位。涟漪免费不用注册，在手机上按 App 设时长，适合能当面设置的孩子手机，也适合自己用。OurPact 不支持小米、OPPO、荣耀、一加。

entry.title: Ripple vs FocusMe and BlockerX: strict app blockers compared
entry.summary: FocusMe has strict plans and computer sync, BlockerX filters adult content and tells a partner about uninstalls, Ripple sets free per app limits on Android with an unlock code. For adults who keep turning their blocker off and for parents.

entry.title: 涟漪和 FocusMe、BlockerX 怎么选：难以绕过的 App 限制对比
entry.summary: FocusMe 计划可以设得很严还能和电脑同步，BlockerX 过滤成人内容并在卸载时通知伙伴，涟漪在安卓上免费按 App 设限制，用解锁码管住放松。写给总关掉限制的大人，也写给家长。

entry.title: Ripple vs Flipd and SPACE: study timer, habit tracker or app blocker
entry.summary: Flipd times study sessions and locks apps while one runs, SPACE tracks screen time and unlocks. Ripple sets rules that stay on all day, for adults studying or working and for parents setting homework time on a child's phone.

entry.title: 涟漪和 Flipd、SPACE 怎么选：学习计时、习惯记录还是 App 限制
entry.summary: Flipd 计时期间锁 App，SPACE 记录屏幕时间和解锁次数，涟漪设整天有效的规则。写给考试季的大人，也写给给孩子设写作业时段的家长。

entry.title: Ripple vs Kidslox and FamiSafe
entry.summary: Paid parental control with remote management and monitoring, or a free app blocker with no account, for parents and for adults.

entry.title: 涟漪和 Kidslox、FamiSafe 怎么选
entry.summary: 带监控的付费家长控制，还是不用注册的免费 App 限制，写给家长和大人自己。

entry.title: Ripple vs Olauncher and minimalist phone
entry.summary: Minimalist launchers hide icons, an app blocker sets limits. What each does for adults and on a child's phone.

entry.title: Ripple vs YourHour and Regain
entry.summary: Floating timers, Reels blocking and Pro plans compared with a free Android app blocker with daily limits and an unlock code.
